note: Board: design/design_handoff_admin_redesign/boards/07-people-flags-operations/signed-out.html is a desktop card over a scrim that covers the sidebar too; the phone shows the same card centred, resolved from it. The kit cannot end a Clerk session, so the overlay's own look cells (Admin People and Admin Venues, 320 / 390 / 1300, Electric and Light) were shot with a local-only query param that forces the overlay on, never committed; the behaviour (Clerk ending the session, a 401 with no token, a 401 with a live token, sign-in again, a stale session clearing) is proven by AdminSessionGuard.test.tsx and api-unauthorized.test.ts. This inventory holds the one cell the kit can run honestly: a 401 from the admin API with a LIVE session must show no overlay. Run with CONTACT_SHEET_ROLE=admin.
